name: Mountain Giant Muisek
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.

The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.

I am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
narrative.objectives: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
narrative.offerRewardText: Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, adventurer. Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.
narrative.requestItemsText: Were you able to capture the mountain giants?

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 45 to 50, 29,325 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
